newsitem.title: USA: Eastman Kodak up on earnings, restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Eastman Kodak up on earnings, restructuring.

text.p: Shares in Eastman Kodak Co rose on Monday, boosted by a company restructuring and fourth quarter earnings, analysts said.
Kodak's stock was up 2-3/8 to 87-5/8 in mid-afternoon on moderate volume of about 820,000 shares.
"I see it as a technical follow-through from the quarterly earnings" announced last week, said Alex Henderson, director of technology research at Prudential Securities.
The company reported earnings of $16 million, or $0.49 a share, in the fourth quarter, with a $256 million charge for a a restructuring that includes the layoff of 4,000 workers worldwide.
Excluding the restructuring charge, earnings were $1.19 a share, above the First Call consensus of $1.12 a share.
"I think people are looking at what Kodak posted and what other companies have been putting up the last couple of days," Henderson said.
Jeffrey Pittsburg, a partner at Goldis-Pittsburg Institutional Services, also said investors had been able to weigh the earnings and layoff news and were reacting positively.
He added that investors also were encouraged by Kodak's increase of its quarterly dividend to $0.44 from $0.40.
